features.description: This sentence means creating PDF files that conform to specific requirements for different purposes. PDF-X and PDF-A are subsets of the PDF format that are defined by ISO standards. PDF-X files are designed to ensure reliable and consistent exchange of graphic content between publishers, printers, and other parties. PDF-A files are intended to preserve the long-term accessibility and readability of documents, regardless of the software or hardware used.
